# Bayl?s Warband Talent and Trait Summary

*Pages PDF 19-20*

WARBAND OF BAYL OF MANY EYES 

## **Bayl’s Warband Talent and Trait Summary**
## Chaos Warrior of Nurgle
**Animosity (Overt Followers of Tzeentch):** If a Chaos Warrior of Nurgle encounters an overt follower of Tzeentch they must make a Cool Test. If they pass they suffer a penalty of -20 to Fellowship Tests made towards the overt follower of Tzeentch. If they fail they are subject to _Animosity_ , and must either socially attack (with insults) or physically attack (with fists or weapons) the overt follower of Tzeentch. Attacks made as a a result of animosity benefit from +1 SL. The Chaos Warrior of Nurgle may test to recover from Animosity at the end of every subsequent round. 

**Armour 5:** Remove 5 points of Damage from attacks to a minimum of 1. Including Toughness Bonus, remove 10 points of Damage from attacks on Chaos Warriors of Nurgle. 

**Champion:** If a Chaos Warrior of Nurgle wins an Opposed Test whilst defending in melee combat, it may inflict damage as if it were an attacker. 

**Corruption (Minor):** A Chaos Warrior of Nurgle is a source of Minor Exposure to corruption. If a character comes into contact with a Chaos Warrior of Nurgle they should make a **Challenging (+0) Endurance** Test or **Challenging (+0) Cool** Test (GM’s choice as to which test). If the Test is failed the character gains 1 Corruption point. 

**Disease (Itching Pox):** A Chaos Warrior of Nurgle is a carrier of Itching Pox. If a Character comes into contact with the Chaos Warrior of Nurgle, or if the Chaos Warrior of Nurgle coughs or sneezes in a Character’s vicitnity then that Character must make an Average (+20) Endurance Test. if the Test is failed they will contract the disease as explained in WFRP, page 186. 

**Distracting:** Living targets within TB yards (typically 5 yards) of a Chaos Warrior of Nurgle suffer a penalty of -20 to all Tests. This penalty only applies once, no matter how many Distracting opponents there are in the vicinity. 

**Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle):** As a result of their Mark of Nurgle, Chaos Warriors of Nurgle may gain bonuses to Fellowship Tests with followers of Nurgle if the GM thinks it is appropriate. 

**Mark of Nurgle:** see page 10. 

## Ryðklumpur and Tannpína
In addition to the Talents and Traits available to a Chaos Warrior of Nurgle, the two Chosen have the following Traits and Talents. 

**Armour 5:** Remove 5 points of Damage from attacks to a minimum of 1. Including Toughness Bonus, remove 11 points of Damage from attacks on Chosen Chaos Warriors of Nurgle. 

**Combat Reflexes:** A Chosen Chaos Warrior of Nurgle has an effective Initiative of 65 when determining turn order in combat. **Resolute:** A Chosen Chaos Warrior of Nurgle gains +1 to their Strength Bonus, and therefore Damage, when they Charge an opponent. 

## Bayl and Dónalegur
In addition to the Talents and Traits available to a Chosen Chaos Warrior of Nurgle, the Exalted Heroes have the following Traits and Talents. 

**Armour 5:** Remove 5 points of Damage from attacks to a minimum of 1. Including Toughness Bonus, remove 12 points of Damage from attacks on Exalted Heroes of Nurgle. 

**Acute Sense (Sight) (Bayl Only):** At the GM’s discretion Bayl may make a Perception Test to notice visible things that would normally go unnoticed by those with more typical sense of sight. 

**Combat Aware:** The Exalted Hero may make a **Challenging (+0) Perception** Test to ignore surprise. 

**Combat Master:** If the Exalted Hero would normally be outnumbered, they count as two combatants for the purposes of working out if they are outnumbered. 

**Inspiring:** With a successful **Challenging (+0) Leadership** Test, the Exalted Hero my use their Leadership Skill on a number of Chaos Warriors equal to 5 times their Fellowship Bonus + SL from the Test. 

**Sixth Sense (Bayl Only):** The GM may decide that Bayl deserves an Intuition Test whenever he is at risk of walking into danger. If he passes the GM ought to provide a form of warning, though details are left to the GM. Bayl may also take an Intuition Test to ignore a _Surprised_ Condition. 

**Warleader:** Any members of the warband who can see the Exalted Hero may add +1 SL to one Willpower Test each round.
